## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Client lint and production build pass when client code changed
- [ ] Server lint, tests, and production build pass when server code changed
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests, or the reason tests are unnecessary is documented
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private data, or generated environment files are included
- [ ] Database changes use a new forward-only numbered migration
- [ ] Deployment and rollback impact has been considered
